{{Quote|Commander Vill&mdash;our scouts have reported back. All indications are that the Nosaurian rebels have been wiped out.''"<br>"''Very good, Lieutenant.''"<br>"''Yes, Commander. What about the civilians? There are transport tracks heading towards the spaceport at Cadgel Meadows&mdash;''"<br>"''Steps have already been taken to deal with that problem.|The lieutenant reports to Commander Vill|<ref name="DT 1" />}}
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] '''lieutenant''' served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]<ref name="DT 1" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The date of [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> serving in [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vill]]'s [[Vill's regiment|regiment]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Half-Axe Pass]], this [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] reported to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Vill that the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]'s [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] indicated that the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]]&mdash;the remaining [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] operating on the planet&mdash;had been wiped out at the battle.<ref name="DT 1" />

The lieutenant then questioned Vill on what was to be done about the Nosaurian civilian population fleeing the battle, which had been seen heading towards the [[Cadgel Meadows spaceport|spaceport]] at [[Cadgel Meadows]]. Vill informed the [[Clone stormtrooper|trooper]] that steps had been taken to deal with them. In actuality, the Nosaurian [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] had been rounded up and sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]<ref name="DT 1" /> on [[Orvax IV]].<ref name="DT 2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref>
